content.text:
The discovery workflow is now running in the background: 8 scoped finders sweep both repos in parallel (andesim scripts/driver/tests/plugin/docs, vsim src/tests, plus a cross-repo sweep for removed-feature markers like the QEMU2 leg, in-tree verilator, gloss_vh), then every candidate goes through an adversarial verifier that tries to refute it by grepping both repos for live references before it can land on the delete list.

Ground rules I set for it:

- Only tracked files count. Untracked/gitignored scratch files at the repo roots (hello32.c, gemm.c, output.log, the PDFs, notebooks) are personal working files, not legacy code - I will list them separately and you decide.
- Submodules are off-limits (andesim `include/`, vsim `external/`) - the shared ABI is pinned by both repos.
- Intentional fallbacks (like `semihost_exit.inc`) are not legacy per CLAUDE.md.

When it finishes I'll show you the confirmed delete list grouped by repo before removing anything, then delete, run the test suite to prove the change is structural-only, and commit per repo.
